create_KimiAudioProcessor: create a KimiAudioProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for Kimi-Audio ASR
call_KimiAudioProcessor: call the KimiAudioProcessor with text and audio inputs to produce a BatchFeature with tokenized outputs
pad_audio_hop_length: pad audio arrays to the feature extractor hop length before feature extraction
rename_audio_keys: rename Whisper feature extractor keys to Kimi-Audio expected keys like whisper_input_features and feature_attention_mask
access_special_token_ids: access Kimi-Audio special token IDs including KIMIA_MEDIA_BEGIN, KIMIA_MEDIA_END, and KIMIA_TEXT_BLANK
